COMNAVRESFORCOM NOTICE 1050
From: Commander, Navy Reserve Forces Command
Subj: FISCAL YEAR 2027 HOLIDAY OBSERVATION GUIDANCE
Ref: (a) COMNAVRESFORCOMINST 1050.1C
1. Purpose. To publish the Commander, Navy Reserve Force (COMNAVRESFOR) and
Commander, Navy Reserve Forces Command (COMNAVRESFORCOM) Fiscal Year (FY)
2027 holiday liberty schedule and tentative FY 2028 first quarter holiday liberty schedule.
2. Scope and Applicability. This notice applies to all personnel assigned to
COMNAVRESFOR and COMNAVRESFORCOM except for designated personnel.
3. Action. COMNAVRESFOR and COMNAVRESFORCOM staff members will adhere to
reference (a) before executing holiday liberty. This notice supersedes
COMNAVRESFORCOMNOTE 1050 of 15 October 2025.
4. Holiday Liberty. The holidays listed below will be observed by COMNAVRESFOR and
COMNAVRESFORCOM during FY 2027. In conjunction with some observed holidays, there
are additional days where holiday routine is authorized.

Holiday Observed Holiday Routine

Thanksgiving 25 Nov 2027 25 - 28 Nov 2027 *+

* 96-hour liberty authorized for military personnel
+ Liberal leave authorized for civilians
6. December 2026 through January 2027 Holiday Leave Period. The holiday leave period for
calendar year 2026 will begin at the close of business on Friday, 11 December 2026, and will
end at the beginning of the day on Monday, 11 January 2027. The deadline for submission of
leave requests will be Friday, 13 November 2026. Military personnel assigned to a duty section
or command duty officers desiring leave during this period will submit requests to their duty
section leader and senior watch officer before routing it through their chain of command. This
must be completed by Monday, 2 November 2026. This is not a standdown period. Deputy
chiefs of staff (DCOS) and special assistants will ensure there is appropriate manning to execute
the mission, functions, and tasks of COMNAVRESFOR and COMNAVRESFORCOM
throughout the leave period. Deviations from the prescribed leave period will be approved at the
DCOS level.
7. Records Management. Records created as a result of this notice, regardless of media or
format, must be managed per Secretary of the Navy Manual 5210.1 of September 2019.
J. M. DROLL
Chief of Staff
Releasability and distribution:
This notice is cleared for public release and is available electronically only via
COMNAVRESFORCOM Web site, https://navyreserve.navy.mil.
